predictor.notes: Best inferred predictor for integer quantities 1..1000, in GBP cents, using the specified rounding rule. It matches all 24 observed prices exactly. Observations support a minimum price through quantity 187, a linear region beginning at 188, and a downward price discontinuity at 460 followed by another linear region. Both transition boundaries were checked at adjacent integer quantities: 187/188 and 459/460. Additional non-round quantities support the final region's cent rounding. Used 24 business requests and 10 REA operations, including inspection; all requests returned unrounded estimates. This is an inferred model, not a verified reconstruction of source logic: unobserved quantities could contain additional changes that the available observations do not reveal.
